propositions: Op-cert service currently performs per-job boto3/SSM/region lookups and patches process-global state, coupling application config to a single secret store and creating concurrency/cleanup hazards.

Signing key and principal must be bound once at startup, validated before queue/worker/network/workspace creation, copied to a process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file permissions, and made immutable for the process lifetime.

Both producer chains (completion path via sign_completion_verdict and plan-review path via generation.sign_manifest/attest.py) must accept and forward an optional OpcertSigner context binding instead of reading key/principal from os.environ.

The op-cert application runtime must have no SSM/boto3/region dependency; the key must be materialized outside the app before startup by fetch-secrets.sh to a 0600 file bind-mounted read-only with REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH.
Concurrent and timed-out jobs must demonstrate context-local signer/principal/push isolation with one immutable startup signer and no workspace push to remote.
Developer-local close/review-plan callers with no injected binding must retain prior env/genesis key resolution unchanged as a regression safeguard.
